dialogues.text:
Hello.
I represent Time Life Corporation. I'm here to apply for a time-credit loan.

Certainly.
How much time credit are you seeking?
Will this time credit be used for corporate operations?

Yes.
Primarily for project expansion and personnel allocation.

Repayment will be deducted from the company's future time revenue.
Do you confirm that you understand the relevant terms?
All right. Your corporate time-loan application meets the requirements, but I need to review the documents you submit before proceeding.
(Hands over the documents) Of course. Here are my documents.
